title: Support reactions and restraints
description: Premium Three.js component comparing pin, roller, and fixed support restraints with spatial reaction vectors.
learningObjectives: Distinguish restrained degrees of freedom and admissible reaction components for common planar structural supports using a spatial model.

rights.attribution: Original LearnMat repository contribution. Runtime uses the declared Three.js 0.185.1 peer; no third-party models, textures, fonts, or datasets are embedded.

verification.notes: 0.2.0 replaces the flat renderer with a host-rendered Three.js scene while preserving the analytical model. Independent engineering, live-browser, screenshot, and accessibility review remain required before approval.

source.reference: Premium 3D rebuild of reserved structures task str-support-reactions; analytical model retained from the original repository contribution.
